_doc: Shared JS/PHP fixtures. Rules: 5+ day scheduled 6–18; shared ≤4 days min 2, no standard max; private from 1.

cases.name: long: 3 confirmed → open (3 is NOT enough any more)
long: 6 confirmed NOT approved → open (no auto-confirm)
long: 16 of 18 + approved → confirmed (no automatic Limited threshold)
short: no standard max → never sold out/limited
legacy booking_cutoff date passed (56 days out, before 45-day review), auto cutoff OFF (default) → stays open
private departure → internal on_request, never public
legacy booking_cutoff date passed (56 days out, before 45-day review), auto cutoff ON (only once approved) → closed
manual Limited flag, still awaiting minimum → limited (admin's call)
sold out needs a capacity: short tour without max never sold out
group: private solo → private on request (quoted separately)

prices.expect: From $1,950 per person on shared departures
From USD 1,950 per person on shared departures

ramadan.source: Astronomical estimate (Umm al-Qura: 1 Ramadan 1448 ≈ Mon 8 Feb 2027; last day ≈ Mon 8 Mar 2027). Local moon sighting may shift ±1 day — confirm in /manage/ when announced.

eid_al_fitr.source: Astronomical estimate (Umm al-Qura: 1 Shawwal 1448 ≈ Tue 9 Mar 2027). Local sighting may shift ±1 day — confirm in /manage/.

eid_al_adha.source: Astronomical estimate (Umm al-Qura: 10 Dhu al-Hijjah 1448 ≈ Sun 16 May 2027). Local sighting may shift ±1 day — confirm in /manage/.

counting.name: inquiry / requested booking does not count
accepted booking without payment received does not count
legacy deposit_recorded counts as payment received
cancelled booking with payment does not count

long_window.name: long 40d / 5, exception but price not re-approved → hidden
long 45d / 6 confirmed, no operational approval → review (approval required)
long 40d capacity reached (no approval) → Sold out, no CTA
long 3d capacity reached → Sold out, no CTA
verified long under-min 20d (legacy-style late case) → review, not public Open
long manual Limited under-min 40d → still review (hidden)
long manual Limited Confirmed 5d → Limited + last-minute CTA
SHORT regression: 3d out, 1 confirmed → Open, normal CTA
SHORT regression: 3d out, 2 + approval → Confirmed, normal CTA
SHORT regression: 40d out, 0 confirmed → Open (no 45-day review)
SHORT regression: 1d out, 0 confirmed → Open (no cutoff)
PRIVATE long 20d → on request, never listed (unchanged)

count_status.name: legacy no data → count unknown (not zero)
legacy unknown 0d (starts today) → shown Closed, not bookable
legacy unknown 45d boundary → manual contact
legacy unknown 46d → normal Open, neutral wording
legacy unknown 7d → last-minute contact
legacy unknown 2d → last-minute contact
legacy unknown 0d (starts today) → shown Closed, not bookable
verified zero 30d → operational-decision workflow (hidden)
reconciled 6+ with approval → Confirmed
reconciled below min + approved exception → allowed
new system departure zero stays zero
unknown legacy never shows '0 confirmed' even with public counts on
SHORT legacy unknown 3d → unchanged (no manual-contact rule)
short 15d / 1 verified → Open (14-day review not yet due)
short 14d / 1 verified, no decision → review (removed from normal booking)
short 10d / 2 + operational approval → Confirmed, still bookable (no short-tour cutoff)
short 10d / 2 without operational approval → review
short 3d / 2 + approval → Confirmed, normal booking (no last-minute cutoff for short tours)
short 10d / 1 + approved exception → Confirmed
short 10d legacy unknown → visible, manual contact
short 20d legacy unknown → unchanged Open wording before the review
regression: short 10d / 1 verified with no short-tour review configured → Open (pre-14-day behaviour)
